query.uji_kasus: Hitung seluruh film
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m a cin:Movie }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung seluruh genre
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?n) WHERE { ?g a cin:Genre }

query.uji_kasus: Tampilkan film bergenre "Drama" (genre paling banyak)
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:genre ?g . ?g rdfs:label "Drama"@en }

query.uji_kasus: Distribusi jumlah film untuk SEMUA genre
query.query: SELECT ?genre (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:genre ?g . ?g rdfs:label ?genre } GROUP BY ?genre

query.uji_kasus: Distribusi jumlah film untuk SEMUA bulan rilis
query.query: SELECT ?bulan (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:datePublished ?d } GROUP BY (SUBSTR(STR(?d), 1, 7) AS ?bulan)

query.uji_kasus: Tampilkan film yang rilis pada bulan 2026-09
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:datePublished ?d . FILTER(?d >= "2026-09-01"^^xsd:date && ?d <= "2026-09-30"^^xsd:date) }

query.uji_kasus: Tampilkan film berdurasi lebih dari 150 menit
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m cin:runtimeMinutes ?r . FILTER(?r > 150) }

query.uji_kasus: Tampilkan film yang disutradarai "Tyler Perry" (sutradara dengan film terbanyak)
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:director ?p . ?p schema:name "Tyler Perry" }

query.uji_kasus: Film paling populer (urut skor popularitas menurun)
query.query: SELECT ?title WHERE { ?m a cin:Movie ; schema:name ?title ; cin:popularity ?p } ORDER BY DESC(?p) LIMIT 1

query.uji_kasus: Hitung pemeran film "Heart of the Beast"
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:name "Heart of the Beast" ; schema:actor ?a }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung peran (karakter) pada film "Heart of the Beast"
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:name "Heart of the Beast" ; cin:hasCastRole ?r . ?r cin:characterName ?c ; cin:byActor ?a }

query.uji_kasus: Aktor yang tampil di film terbanyak
query.query: SELECT ?name (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:actor ?a . ?a schema:name ?name } GROUP BY ?a ?name ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

query.uji_kasus: Tampilkan film bergenre "Comedy" sekaligus "Drama" (kombinasi paling umum)
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m schema:genre ?g1 , ?g2 . ?g1 rdfs:label "Comedy"@en . ?g2 rdfs:label "Drama"@en }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung film yang tertaut ke Wikidata (owl:sameAs)
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m a cin:Movie ; owl:sameAs ?w . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?w), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q")) }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung film yang BELUM tertaut ke Wikidata
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?m a cin:Movie . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?m owl:sameAs ?w } }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung seluruh bioskop
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a cin:Cinema }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung bioskop dengan koordinat geografis valid
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a cin:Cinema ; schema:geo ?geo . ?geo a cin:GeoCoordinates ; schema:latitude ?lat ; schema:longitude ?lng }

query.uji_kasus: Distribusi bioskop berdasarkan jaringan
query.query: SELECT ?chain (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a cin:Cinema ; cin:cinemaChain ?chain } GROUP BY ?chain

query.uji_kasus: Hitung seluruh auditorium
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a) AS ?n) WHERE { ?a a cin:Auditorium }

query.uji_kasus: Auditorium terhubung ke bioskop induknya
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a) AS ?n) WHERE { ?a a cin:Auditorium ; cin:partOfCinema ?cinema }

query.uji_kasus: Hitung seluruh jadwal tayang
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s a cin:ScreeningEvent }

query.uji_kasus: Jadwal tayang terhubung ke film, bioskop, dan waktu mulai
query.query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s a cin:ScreeningEvent ; schema:workPresented ?movie ; cin:heldAtCinema ?cinema ; schema:startDate ?start }
